unsure.why: No OSV or GitHub source verifies: Forgejo is on Codeberg, and the Go module codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo stops at v1.20.0 (2023), far behind the pinned 17.0.1. Watch https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo security releases by hand.
GitLab is not on GitHub and has no OSV package; advisories come from about.gitlab.com/releases. Only the vendor package name is listed.
GitLab-hosted; Go module gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab-runner resolves only to v11.11.4+incompatible (2019), so it was dropped. Only the vendor package name is listed.
First-party Conn3x software, not third-party, so left out; the circuit's curl, git, tar, gzip and openssh-client are listed.

Composes 23 other circuits at older module tags (e.g. circuit-homepage?ref=v0.1.0, circuit-wazuh?ref=v0.2.0). Its circuits are listed under each main piece of software, but pinned defaults reflect origin/main of the source circuits, not those tags.
Composes circuit-uptimekuma and circuit-homepage at ref v0.1.0; pinned defaults reflect origin/main, not those tags.

Images for Flux controllers, Istio pilot/proxyv2, Rancher, cert-manager and flannel come from upstream manifests/charts the circuit applies, not from circuit defaults; repositories were inferred from upstream conventions, not read from the manifests.
Runs cgr.dev/chainguard/minio:latest pinned only by digest; upstream minio/minio GitHub repo is archived, so new repository advisories may not appear there.

unsure.why: These install whatever npm packages, Go tools, pip packages, gems, CPAN or distro modules, PHP extensions or Cockpit pages the user lists; nothing by default, so none are in the watchlist.

packages from vendor repositories (grafana, falco, netdata, teleport, wazuh, zabbix, mysql-community-server, mssql-server, docker-ce, etc.) are not in the Debian/Ubuntu/Rocky OSV feeds; match them via the github/osv sources instead.

cri-o, cri-tools, openshift-clients, runc and containernetworking-plugins come from mirror.openshift.com / CentOS Stream koji URLs pinned in the dependency_rpms default; versions are in those URLs, not separate variables.
